gate: Gate-W (verbatim reuse of configs/p1_gates.json; no threshold moved)
W_note: The official evaluator emits no separate val_time module; per the 2026-08-26 P1 caliber correction the 10% slot is filled by S3 FC alone and this substitution is recorded, never silently replaced by another stratum.

bootstrap.clusters: 6 unseen compounds + 1 unseen strain BAI = 7 clusters

conditions: no module has negative delta with CI excluding 0
dW_noS2 must also pass; if dW passes but dW_noS2 does not, NOT ADOPTED
floor_provenance: +0.010 = frozen S1 effect floor 0.053 (6 clusters, cluster-bootstrap SD 0.0265) x official module weight 0.20. Carried over unchanged from P1. Never to be lowered.

gate_z_zero_information.rationale: Standing project position since 2026-08-16: an S1 gain produced by re-weighting the shared -y_control term carries zero compound information and must not enter the submission (this is why R1 convex mixing is never adopted).
gate_z_zero_information.rule: For any candidate, run scripts/compound_invariance_check.py. If the candidate is compound-invariant (cross-compound prediction pairs bitwise identical within a context) AND the S1 term contributes more than 50% of its dW, the candidate is NOT ADOPTED and is reported as a zero-information control.

gate_r1_free.rule: No P3 candidate may contain R1 convex control mixing. Any RAP component must be the r1-free variant, asserted by reading r1.weight from the run_config.yaml of every contributing run and by parquet identity check against metrics.json.
gate_r1_free.provenance: M1 rejected w>=0.30 under the dual-granularity rule; the P1-evaluated RAP-R4 candidate was rap_r4_hybrid_r1_mix with r1.weight=0.30 and is therefore excluded from P3 as a component.

selection_rules.R3A_advance_rule: the 3 configs with the lowest 3-seed ensemble RMSE, plus COMBO, are evaluated on the official evaluator; all configs are reported
selection_rules.R3A_combo_rule: COMBO = the coordinatewise argmin level on each of the three axes (epochs, embedding_dim, mask_p) by 3-seed ensemble RMSE. If all three argmins are the base level, COMBO is skipped and recorded as skipped.
selection_rules.R3B_grid: ema_decay in {0.99, 0.995, 0.999}, base config (40 epochs, dim 64, mask_p 0.25), seeds {20260810, 3407, 42}
selection_rules.R3C_primary: C1 global convex blend at w = 0.50 is the single pre-declared primary candidate; C0 and all other w values are reported as an exploratory curve and are not adoptable on their own

hard_constraints: split_final frozen; fit only on split_final == train (5,920 rows)
validation used for model selection only, never for fitting any statistic
Goai_TorchDragon/ and submission_package/ must not be modified in P3
no threshold in this file may be changed after any P3 result is seen
